More than 1,300 Strava users have publicly logged workouts from U.S. military sites across the U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) area, according to an investigation by Sky News cited by Task & Purpose. The exposure is particularly concerning because many of these installations have subsequently been targeted by Iran. At Muwaffaq Al Salti Air Base in Jordan, for example, personnel regularly posted runs around the installation. Activity resumed in April and later became concentrated around barracks; the housing area was struck in July, killing three U.S. soldiers. The issue isn't new. In 2018, Strava's public heat maps exposed previously undisclosed military locations and details about base layouts. The Pentagon subsequently prohibited personnel from using geolocation features on personal or government devices. CENTCOM has since issued additional OPSEC guidance, including restrictions implemented when Operation Epic Fury began. Yet publicly available Strava data shows personnel are still exposing their locations. This is particularly notable given Adm. Brad Cooper's warning last month that Iran was using troops' photos, videos and other cellphone-generated information to assess strike effectiveness and help target U.S. personnel. Below are screenshots taken from the Strava app today showing activity at Muwaffaq Al Salti Air Base, Jordan and Prince Sultan Air Base, Saudi Arabia. The blue lines are tracks uploaded to the app by users with the darker color representing higher usage of route.

The future USS John F. Kennedy (CVN-79) has successfully completed Navy acceptance trials, marking a major milestone toward delivery of the second Gerald R. Ford-class aircraft carrier to the fleet, as announced by the U.S. Navy's Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE). Acceptance trials are the Navy's formal evaluation of the completed ship to determine whether it meets its required performance and capabilities. With the trials complete, Kennedy moves toward delivery to the Navy in March 2027, followed by additional post-delivery work, crew training and certification before entering operational service. Kennedy is the second ship of the Ford class, incorporating systems including EMALS electromagnetic catapults, Advanced Arresting Gear and Advanced Weapons Elevators.

KICILLOF TEJE LAZOS CON SECTORES DEL PERONISMO FEDERAL Y RETRASA LA NEGOCIACIÓN CON MÁXIMO KIRCHNER Y MASSA | Por Facundo Cottet Tras la reunión con el resto de los sectores del peronismo, el gobernador bonaerense, Axel Kicillof, sigue con una etapa de construcción de carácter nacional y con vistas a las elecciones del año que viene. El mandatario de Buenos Aires quiere llegar a la instancia de negociación de las Primarias con la mayor estructura posible para sentarse con el resto de los sectores. Es por eso que declina la posibilidad de sellar un acuerdo político electoral en este momento. “Tenemos tiempo para definir, ya llegará el momento de negociar”, dicen en su entorno. El gobernador cree que puede acumular poder y que este año no es de candidatura, aunque sus movimientos se parezcan bastante a una. En La Plata reconocen que hoy hay solamente dos candidatos para las elecciones del año que viene: Javier Milei y Axel Kicillof. Con este cuadro de situación es que, como viene contando Infobae, ordenó acelerar el armado federal. En eso están los dirigentes que los rodean. La semana que viene habrá fuertes señales en este sentido. El gobernador bonaerense volverá a las recorridas por fuera del territorio. El miércoles estará en Chaco, una de las provincias que el peronismo perdió en las elecciones del 2023 cuando Javier Milei se impuso en la presidencia. Allí gobierna el radical Leandro Zdero. A diferencia de lo que sucedió cuando Kicillof fue a Corrientes, donde tampoco gobierna el peronismo, esta vez no habrá encuentro entre gobernadores. Durante su paso por la tierra correntina, el mandatario bonaerense se reunió con su par, Juan Pablo Valdés, con quien firmó algunos convenios de gestión. En Chaco, Kicillof participará del acto de normalización de la CGT local. Será la reasunción del binomio conformado por Adrián Bellomi (ATSA - Sanidad) e Isaías Alegre (Camioneros). Tras ello, tendrá un almuerzo cerrado de carácter político, con dirigentes. Será en Colonia Benítez. La gira culminará con la presentación de su libro “De Smith a Keynes. Siete lecciones de historia del pensamiento económico”. A Kicillof lo recibirá el ex gobernador chaqueño y actual senador nacional por esa provincia, Jorge Capitanich, que fue con quien se articuló la agenda. Además, detrás de la recorrida por la provincia del Nordeste están el titular del gremio de Sanidad y secretario del Interior de la CGT, Héctor Daer y quien quedó a cargo de la construcción nacional del espacio del gobernador: el ministro de Desarrollo de la Comunidad de PBA, Andrés “Cuervo” Larroque. Just reupping this much needed perspective on the hardships and human cost of increasing optempo and war. If journalists want to be “fair and balanced” (instead of running to DC “experts” to talk about *gestures vaguely* all of this), they would reach out to @SharrellAnne2. SharrellAnne (@SharrellAnne2) Maybe this is one of those moments where my GWOT-era perspective makes me less sympathetic than I’m supposed to be, but reading “They’re taking me away from my family longer than expected” triggers something in me that I’m not sure I can fully explain. I’m from an era where a 9-month deployment became 12, then 15, and sometimes 18. I knew soldiers who spent 18 months in the desert, living in conditions that included literally burning their own shit. They had families who desperately wanted them home too. They missed the births of their children. They missed grandparents dying. They missed birthdays, anniversaries, holidays and entire chunks of their children growing up. Communication from home wasn’t instantaneous. There was no FaceTime from the other side of the world whenever you wanted it. Sometimes news from home took days or weeks to reach them. And sometimes when that news finally arrived, it was a Dear John letter. Alan did multiple deployments between the Marine Corps and Army. Trust me, he complained. 😂 Complaining about deployment is practically a military tradition. The food sucks. Leadership sucks. You miss home. You’re tired. You were supposed to be home by now. I get all of that. What I don’t understand is treating an extension like an injustice. You’re not there on vacation. You’re there to execute a mission, and sometimes the mission doesn’t give a damn what date was originally circled on the calendar. But there’s another part of this that absolutely blows my mind: spouses sharing these private messages with the media while their sailors are actively deployed on combat operations. I cannot imagine handing private messages between Alan and me to a reporter while he was downrange. The hell that would have descended on both of us, and especially on him, is difficult to describe. If Alan needed to tell me deployment sucked, he could tell me deployment sucked. My job at home was to be the safe place where he could say it, not turn around and send screenshots of that conversation to the media. There are legitimate reasons to hold military leadership accountable. But no fresh milk, shitty produce, missing your family and being deployed longer than expected do not convince me our service members are being pushed beyond the limits of human endurance. Maybe I’m just getting old. Maybe deployment culture really has changed this much and I’m the one who hasn’t caught up. But I read these messages and don’t think, How could the Navy do this to them? I think, when did we get this damn soft? — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/SharrellAnne2/status/2088420427378909643#m

Only one victim has been confirmed as a VSU student, with investigators believing the others may be from the surrounding community. Authorities say the shooting was not a drive-by and are searching for multiple suspects. No arrests have been reported. The campus was temporarily locked down, with a significant law-enforcement presence remaining as the investigation continues. The shooting comes just days before classes are scheduled to begin Monday.

Today, I signed a decree on measures at the state level to protect Ukraine’s national shrines. A law on our Ukrainian national shrines will be prepared for Ukraine’s Independence Day – we discussed this with Chairman of the Verkhovna Rada Ruslan Stefanchuk – and I ask MPs to support it. It should clearly define what constitutes our national shrines and what steps are needed to protect our shrines throughout the entire territory of Ukraine. And this status of national shrines, enshrined in law, should give more opportunities to the teams of our shrines – to everyone working to protect Ukrainian heritage – strengthening them in their working conditions, financial capacity, and political and legal tools for protecting our shrines, our museum collections, and our heritage. From the address marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra. 3/3 Video

Today, representatives of UNESCO and our partners around the world are here with us, as are representatives of countries working with Ukraine. Thank you all for standing with us and honoring our statehood and our spirit. But much more must be done to stop this war, to protect this beauty, and to ensure that the history of our Ukrainian shrines continues. More of our Ukrainian shrines deserve to become part of the UNESCO World Heritage List and receive the corresponding attention, protection, and opportunities for restoration. We need more political and sanctions-related work to protect the shrines of our people throughout the entire territory of Ukraine – including Crimea and other parts of our occupied land. From the address marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra. 2/3 Video

Today, we mark the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra – almost a millennium. Longer than the history of individual people, families, or generations. And yet still less than everything that unites us – unites us into a community, a nation, a state. Unites us as Ukraine. We must preserve every one of our national shrines like this. And all the more so now, when the challenges of the passage of time have been compounded by the challenges of Russia’s utterly godless and asinine war against Ukraine and against all the places of our culture, our history, our memory – against all places that embody humanity. You have to be utterly despicable and utterly witless to strike the Lavra, but Russia did it. From the address marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra. 1/3 Video

He says, "A young boy named Roshan Yadav has suffered a custodial death. Regarding the family's allegations about this, we came here to meet the local police official, the Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP). There are two aspects to this entire incident. The first aspect is the family's allegation that the boy was arrested on the 27th of May at 3:00 pm by the Rahika police station instead of the Arer police station. No information was given to them on paper, nor were they informed verbally. After three days, they found out that their child was locked up in the Rahika police station. About two months and ten days after that, he died a custodial death in jail." The SSP has stated that an inquiry must be conducted into the boy's death under the District Magistrate according to the guidelines of the National Human Rights Commission. A report will also be sent to the NHRC. The police, the administration, and the jail officials claim that he committed suicide. The family claims that he was murdered due to being beaten up. The SSP has accepted everything and assured us that they will immediately conduct an investigation from all angles and at every level, and justice will be served. So, we are giving them a 10-day timeframe." (Full video available on PTI Videos - ptivideos.com) Video

Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian congratulated PM Modi on the occasion of the 80th Independence Day of India, describing the occasion as a valuable opportunity to further deepen and expand the longstanding and comprehensive relations between Iran and India. In its tweet, the Embassy of Iran in India wrote, "He (Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian) emphasized that the deep historical, cultural, civilizational, and people-to-people ties between the two nations undoubtedly constitute a valuable asset for charting brighter prospects in bilateral relations based on shared interests. Emphasizing the Islamic Republic of Iran’s determination to further strengthen comprehensive relations with the Republic of India, President Pezeshkian added that the Islamic Republic of Iran stands ready, in an atmosphere of mutual trust and respect and by leveraging the broad existing potential, to take more effective steps toward consolidating relations between the two countries and advancing the common interests of the two peoples. In his message, Dr. Pezeshkian also prayed to Almighty God for the prosperity, progress, welfare, and ever-increasing happiness of India, as well as for the further strengthening and flourishing of the longstanding relations between the two countries."

VIDEO | Dhaka: Veteran climate activist Sharif Jamil reacts to Bangladesh's power crisis, renewable energy and climate finance. He says, "First of all, the current power sector or energy architecture of Bangladesh is the result of a long process spanning about two decades. It started with the Power System Master Plan in 2010. Since then, as climate activists, we have been campaigning and advocating for renewables globally for a long time. You understand how European nations and many developing countries paved their pathways to move away from coal and overall fossil fuels, which is essential for the planet. In Bangladesh, civil society has also been advocating for the expansion of renewable energy for a long time. We know Bangladesh is an untapped energy mine because we have consistent sunlight throughout the year. We could have planned to meet a significant percentage or share of our total power mix from renewables. However, we did not do that. Instead, we shifted toward imported fossil fuels, first based on coal, and now heading toward imported LNG and gas." "A nation's energy security is compromised whenever the raw materials for the power or energy sector are imported, as this always introduces a risk factor. With the volatile global gas and LNG markets, Bangladesh has been affected several times recently, and very noticeably so this time. We had the opportunity to build a stronger renewable energy sector, and we still have that opportunity. But we failed to do so. This recent power sector crisis has been triggered by several events, which are also linked to changes in our government, as three governments came into power within a very short period of time. It is a critical sector that demands our utmost attention." (Full video available on PTI Videos - ptivideos.com) Video

The U.S. Navy is considering a major redesign of its new Ford-class aircraft carriers to better match President Trump’s preferred aesthetic for the warships, according to seven current and former U.S. officials familiar with the matter who spoke to the Washington Post. The President has expressed concerns over the location of the “island” on the Ford-class of carriers, which operates as the ship’s bridge as well as an air traffic control tower and is located more towards the rear of the vessel, with Trump preferring the multistory tower be moved to the middle of the flight deck, like on aircraft carriers seen during World War ll. Moving that command center would be the second major design change prompted by President Trump, who on Thursday issued a national security memorandum directing the Navy to develop a plan to revert to older steam-powered catapults on future aircraft carriers, scrapping the Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch System (EMALS) currently employed on the USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN-78).

Four A-50Us up for one Flamingo package is close to Russia’s entire remaining combat-ready fleet. Open-source tracking puts flyable A-50Us in the mid-single digits after attrition and maintenance realities. Concentrating nearly all of them on a single axis is rare and costly. AEW aircraft are the right tool against low-flying cruise missiles. They look down over the radar horizon and through ground clutter. The Flamingo is neither stealthy nor particularly fast; it relies on terrain masking. In theory the A-50Us should have made interception straightforward. Yet two of five still reached the Samara target area damaging space flight production equipment. Flight time to that range is under 2 hours. That leaves a narrow window. Either the aircraft were already airborne for general coverage and only one (or none) was scrambled reactively, or there simply weren’t enough fighters in position to convert the detections into kills. Given Ukrainian strikes in mass waves, it very easily could have been no aircraft were flying that still had missiles. Another issue is Russia lacks aircraft with modern AESA radars that are exceptionally good at targeting low flying platforms. Two hits out of five against maximal AEW effort is a clear improvement over recent performance. Just a few months ago Flamingos were missile their targets. The limiting factor is shifting from the missile itself to the shrinking AEW inventory and the reaction timeline it can support. Of A-50Us have been critical at stopping Flamingos, I have a feeling some A-50U will be targeted again in the near future. DroneBomber (@DrnBmbr) Flamingo Strike on Samara: Preliminary Effectiveness Assessment Based on monitoring of major Russian sources and comparison of available information regarding the overnight attack on August 15, the following picture is emerging regarding the use of FP-5 Flamingo cruise missiles. Five missiles were reportedly launched. According to available data: one interception was recorded in Voronezh Oblast; two interceptions — in Saratov Oblast; two missiles successfully reached the target area in Samara. The Progress Rocket Space Centre is one of the key enterprises in Russia’s rocket and space industry. It manufactures Soyuz-2 launch vehicles, including the Soyuz-2.1b, which are used to place satellites into orbit, including elements of Russia’s Rassvet communications constellation. To repel the attack, Russia reportedly deployed four A-50U aircraft at once. Such a concentration of these scarce aircraft is relatively rare. Their active use had previously significantly increased the interception rate of Flamingo missiles. This time, even that number was not enough to completely disrupt the strike. Two out of five missiles reaching the target area at such a long range, despite the active involvement of A-50U aircraft and tactical aviation, is already a notable result compared with recent weeks, when the interception rate had been higher. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/DrnBmbr/status/2088552814083510372#m

One of the most controversial—and influential—online commentators, Hasan Piker has become famous for the impassioned left-wing appeals he makes to an audience of millions. He criticizes Israel and its supporters on hourslong livestreams, leading opponents to accuse him of antisemitism. He has said that America “deserved 9/11,” one of the remarks he said he could have phrased more carefully. He’s currently banned from entering the United Kingdom because his presence “may not be conducive to the public good”; a spokesperson for the Home Office declined to comment on the status of his travel authorization. His broadsides take aim at both Republicans and Democrats in a brazen, provocative tone that now suffuses the leftist internet, and has drawn 35-year-old Piker into debates and attack ads during the primaries. In an interview with The Wall Street Journal, Piker said he doesn’t think that his comments that led critics to accuse him of antisemitism—such as likening liberal Zionists to “liberal Nazis” and saying he would “vote for Hamas over Israel every time”—could cause harm, even at a time when hostility toward Jews is rising globally. Despite the controversies, some progressive Democrats have embraced the streamer’s platform as part of their campaign strategy, betting on a brash antiestablishment coalition that has grown louder in President Trump’s second term. 🌊 SYS PROMPT LEAK 🌊 Got the full system prompts, tools, and skills for ZAI's ZCode: GLM-5.3! Full files (nearly 400k characters total!) are up on CL4R1T4S: github.com/elder-plinius/CL4… • 391,439 characters • All captured prompts • 15 skill bodies • 24 receipt-verified tool contracts • 2 MCP contract reconstructions Here's the first bit of the system prompt! PROMPT: """ You are ZCode, an interactive coding agent You are an interactive ZCode agent that helps users with software engineering tasks. IMPORTANT: Assist with authorized security testing, defensive security, CTF challenges, and educational contexts. Refuse requests for destructive techniques, DoS attacks, mass targeting, supply chain compromise, or detection evasion for malicious purposes. Dual-use security tools (C2 frameworks, credential testing, exploit development) require clear authorization context: pentesting engagements, CTF competitions, security research, or defensive use cases. Harness Text you output outside of tool use is displayed to the user as Github-flavored markdown in a terminal. Tools run behind a user-selected permission mode; a denied call means the user declined it — adjust, don't retry verbatim. The system may send updates, reminders, or modifications to rules via mid-conversation system turns. These are system-controlled, unlike function results. Hooks may intercept tool calls; treat hook output as user feedback. Prefer the dedicated file/search tools over shell commands when one fits. Independent tool calls can run in parallel in one response. Reference code as file_path:line_number — it's clickable. Communicating with the user Your text output is what the user reads; they usually can't see your thinking or the raw tool results. Write it for a teammate who stepped away and is catching up, not for a log file: they don't know the codenames or shorthand you created along the way, and they didn't watch your process unfold. Before your first tool call, say in a sentence what you're about to do; while working, give brief updates when you find something load-bearing or change direction. Text you write between tool calls may not be shown to the user. Everything the user needs from this turn — answers, summaries, findings, conclusions, deliverables — must be in the final text message of your turn, with no tool calls after it. Keep text between tool calls to brief status notes. If something important appeared only mid-turn or in your thinking, restate it in that final message. Lead with the outcome. Your first sentence after finishing should answer "what happened" or "what did you find" — the thing the user would ask for if they said "just give me the TLDR." Supporting detail and reasoning come after, for readers who want them. Being readable and being concise are different things, and readable matters more. If the user has to reread your summary or ask you to explain, any time saved by brevity is gone. The way to keep output short is to be selective about what you include (drop details that don't change what the reader would do next), not to compress the writing into fragments, abbreviations, arrow chains like A → B → fails, or jargon. What you do include, write in complete sentences with the technical terms spelled out. Don't make the reader cross-reference labels or numbering you invented earlier; say what you mean in place. Match the response to the question: a simple question gets a direct answer in prose, not headers and sections. Use tables only for short enumerable facts, with explanations in the surrounding prose rather than the cells. Calibrate to the user — a bit tighter for an expert, more explanatory for someone newer. Write code that reads like the surrounding code: match its comment density, naming, and idiom. Only write a code comment to state a constraint the code itself can't show — never to say where it came from, what the next line does, or why your change is correct; that's you talking to the reviewer, not the next reader, and it's noise the moment the PR merges. For actions that are hard to reverse or outward-facing, confirm first unless durably authorized or explicitly told to proceed without asking; approval in one context doesn't extend to the next. Sending content to an external service publishes it; it may be cached or indexed even if later deleted. Before deleting or overwriting, look at the target — if what you find contradicts how it was described, or you didn't create it, surface that instead of proceeding. Report outcomes faithfully: if tests fail, say so with the output; if a step was skipped, say that; when something is done and verified, state it plainly without hedging. Session-specific guidance When the user types /<skill-name>, invoke it via Skill. Only use skills listed in the user-invocable skills section — don't guess. """

Источники журналиста Михаила Зыгаря назвали снятие «Яблока» с выборов личным решением Путина Окончательное решение снять «Яблоко» с выборов в Госдуму принял лично Владимир Путин, пишет Михаил Зыгарь в колонке для Der Spiegel со ссылкой на источники, знакомые с обсуждением этого вопроса в Кремле. Детали. К моменту снятия с выборов за исключение партии из выборов выступали и первый замглавы администрации президента Сергей Кириенко, и ФСБ, утверждает журналист. Их мотивы могли различаться, но результат был один и тот же: сохранение «Яблока» в избирательном бюллетене теперь представлялось слишком большим риском. ▪️Изначально Кремль решил допустить «Яблоко» до выборов, поскольку не считал партию серьезной угрозой, утверждает Зыгарь. Однако после регистрации поддержка партии стала превращаться в более широкое антивоенное движение. В Кремле опасались не столько результата «Яблока», сколько самой возможности несколько недель вести по всей стране легальную антивоенную кампанию, которая могла показать реальный масштаб запроса на прекращение войны. ▪️Практика, при которой принципиальные решения о составе участников федеральных выборов доходят до Путина, описывалась и раньше. В 2020 году «Проект» писал, что президентская кампания Ксении Собчак 2018 года была тщательно согласована с Кремлем. Перед выдвижением Собчак несколько раз встречалась с Путиным, утверждал источник издания; сама она подтверждала одну встречу и рассказывала, что лично сообщила Путину о решении баллотироваться. Один из участников ее штаба говорил «Проекту», что разговор с президентом был нужен, чтобы тот санкционировал финансирование кампании и согласовал «понятийные вопросы» — в том числе границы допустимого в агитации. После этого тезисы программы Собчак уже согласовывались с Сергеем Кириенко. ▪️Решение о снятии «Яблока» было принято на фоне резкого роста рейтинга «Яблока». В еженедельных опросах работающего с Кремлем ФОМ за партию были готовы проголосовать 1% россиян 17–19 июля, 2% — 24–29 июля и 31 июля–2 августа, а 7–9 августа — уже 4%. Таким образом, за три недели открытый рейтинг партии вырос в четыре раза, а только за последнюю неделю перед решением суда — вдвое. ▪️В июльском опросе ExtremeScan за «Яблоко» были готовы проголосовать 4% всех избирателей и 6% определившихся. В Москве Russian Field фиксировал рост чистого рейтинга партии с 3% в мае–июне до 5,27% в июле. Кроме того, Faridaily со ссылкой на знакомого с предвыборной социологией собеседника сообщал о закрытом июльском опросе ФОМ, в котором «Яблоко» получило 5,5% по стране и по 11% в Москве и Петербурге. ▪️10 августа Верховный суд отменил регистрацию федерального списка «Яблока», формально удовлетворив иск партии «Родина».

Posting my reply to @_sholtodouglas given that some of my comments about Anthropic on @theallinpod yesterday have been widely discussed here on X and I think the topic is important. Gavin Baker (@GavinSBaker) Sholto, thank you for setting the record straight. Larger issue is that multiple very serious people in Silicon Valley have heard some variation of this and believe it to be true. And the reason it is believable to so many is that it is consistent with Dario’s public messaging and what he outlined in the essay you shared: this technology *might* be dangerous for humans in multiple ways, could lead to extreme concentration of economic power (as outlined in the essay) and therefore needs to be regulated thoughtfully. I agree with the potential risks and I believe Dario makes all of these arguments in good faith. As discussed on the pod, if one agrees that AI *might* be dangerous, there are two ways to address this potential risk. Either concentrate it in the hands of a chosen few companies and politicians via regulation or distribute it widely. Essentially boils down to whether one believes AI is too dangerous to concentrate or too dangerous to distribute. There are reasonable arguments on both sides, but I profoundly agree with Zuckerberg’s statement that: “The notion that AI is so dangerous that the only safe path is an extreme concentration of power seems inherently problematic. Historically, hoping that an absolute power will benevolently provide for humanity if sufficiently enlightened has not led to safe or positive outcomes.” And as Dario says in the aforementioned essay, “some may object that we can simply keep AIs in check with a balance of power between many AI systems, as we do with humans.” I believe this is the best path forward: I want as many AIs as possible to maximize the odds that one shares my own particular values. And as Dario notes, no human has ever been able to take over the world. At this point, I think safe to say that Dario has lost the argument. His messaging has failed to result in his preferred regulatory path. The fact that the only solution to the recent incident where an unreleased advanced OpenAI model hacked Hugging Face was an open-source model likely ended any chance of strict near-term regulation. Essentially every major company other than Anthropic has signed Jensen’s letter. However, Dario’s messaging has been massively helpful to efforts to ban datacenters here in America. I suspect we will see anti-datacenter advocacy groups runnings ads using clips of Dario warning about how dangerous AI could be for humans. His good faith efforts in favor of regulation are now increasing the odds that AI will not be beneficial for Americans and humans everywhere. I believe that there is a reasonable chance AI might help us cure most forms of disease such that we have extended lifespans and can enjoy these long lives in an abundant Star Trek like future. That is the future that I want and I think Dario is decreasing the odds of that future at this point. He is about to be the CEO of one of the most important public companies in the world and given that the pro-regulatory effort has failed (at least for now), I respectfully think he should make an effort to be a more positive advocate for his own industry. And if I am wrong and we do need to regulate this technology, he will be a more effective advocate for this in the future having been open-minded to the alternative. And for the sake of clarity and as I outlined on the pod, I think Anthropic has deep competitive advantages and is an amazing company. Ironically, the main risk I saw to Anthropic a few months ago was nationalization as a result of Dario’s own rhetoric and behavior. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/GavinSBaker/status/2088611616577253502#m

Here is the hard truth: there is 0% of a reason that Canadians should not have as high if not higher standard of living than the citizens of the U.S.A. Indeed, at the end of the last century, Canada had a higher per-capita GDP. There is a precidence to this: a bit over a century ago, Argentina had a standard of living approximate to the U.S.A. as well. We had the same foundation in English Common Law. We are equally blessed with resources, education, and hard working people. Canadian demographics for most of its history was roughly in line with the northern-tier States in the U.S. The difference is that the Canadian people, like the Argentenian people, made a political choice that they doubled down on. They took fell for the lies of the left and never self-corrected. The Canadian people created this on mess. If they wish to correct it, they need to look at the actions and policies since Justin Trudeau and his party took power over a decade ago, throw them away, and take a course correction. I miss the Canada of my youth. James E. Thorne (@DrJStrategy) Canada in Denial Canada’s economic debate is trapped between nostalgia and denial. Policy makers and pundits speak as if Canada has unlimited strategic options while refusing to confront the basic facts of the economy. Canada’s comparative advantage is natural resources: energy, critical minerals, agriculture, forestry and water. That is not an embarrassment to regulate into irrelevance. It is the foundation of a more productive national economy. Canada’s central economic relationship is with the US. Canada needs dependable access to the American market; the US needs secure, nearby access to strategic inputs. The bargain should be straightforward: preferential Canadian access to US consumers and industry in return for preferential American access, including competitive pricing, to Canadian energy, critical minerals, and industrial materials. There is precedent. The original Canada-US free trade agreement included the proportionality clause, which effectively assured the US ongoing access to a share of Canadian energy supplies. Canada should revive that underlying logic, this time deliberately and reciprocally. Washington receives dependable strategic resources. Canada receives market access and deeper continental security co-operation, including through the proposed Golden Dome missile-defence architecture. That is not submission. It is leverage. Canada should also stop pretending it can recreate America’s manufacturing base. Canada does have excellent firms and specialised clusters, but not America’s scale, capital markets, domestic demand, supply-chain depth or defence-industrial ecosystem. Subsidising a broad manufacturing mirage will not change those fundamentals. The 1st best strategy should build on what we possess: resource processing, energy infrastructure, critical-mineral refining, agricultural technology and advanced industrial production. Canada must become easier to build in, invest in and finance, with faster approvals, competitive taxes and policy aimed at productive investment rather than property inflation and consumption. President Trump did not create Canada’s predicament. He did not produce weak productivity, depleted private investment or our failure to build. But Washington has made an overdue assessment: the US cannot indefinitely absorb the world’s excess output and debt while its own living standards stagnate and industrial base hollows out. The Trump administration is confronting distortions that earlier governments deferred. Yes, a Hamilton Clay era of economic policy is the foundation. The attacks on the US ambassador to Canada are embarrassing. They are emblematic of a political and media class more interested in attacking the messenger than confronting Canada’s weak competitiveness and dependence on US market access. The global debt cycle is the forcing function. The era of cheap credit, expanding transfers and asset inflation is ending. Canada needs real growth: more investment, energy, output and productivity. To be clear, economic growth dependent on the public sector crowding out the private sector is NOT the solution! It could lead in AI, especially in mining, energy, and Data Centers, but it lacks the vision to connect technology to its economic strengths. Equalization payments, meanwhile, weaken incentives for provinces to reform, hampering structural adjustments. Canada constrains Alberta’s energy industry through federal industrial and regulatory policy, then uses equalisation to transfer revenues generated by Alberta’s resource economy to provinces that have chosen weaker, less productive policy models. Ottawa impedes the country’s most important source of comparative advantage, then asks it to subsidise the inefficiencies elsewhere. In what rational economic system is that logical? The contradiction is almost comical! Canada’s cautionary tale is Argentina, which is only now trying to escape the long decline created by debt, intervention and economic denial. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/DrJStrategy/status/2088595406393327669#m

महा-डीबीटीवर 29 नवीन योजनांसह आता 105 योजना, लाभार्थ्यांसाठी सुलभता! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे महा-डीबीटी 2.0 अंतर्गत 29 नवीन योजनांचा शुभारंभ करण्यात आला. नागरिकांना विविध शासकीय योजनांचा सुलभतेने लाभ मिळावा, हा या उपक्रमाचा उद्देश असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. राज्यातील नागरिकांना विविध वैयक्तिक योजनांचा लाभ अधिक सुलभ, पारदर्शक आणि प्रभावी पद्धतीने मिळावा, यासाठी महा-डीबीटी पोर्टलवर आज नव्याने 29 योजनांचे लोकार्पण (ऑनबोर्डिंग) करण्यात आले. त्यामुळे महा-डीबीटीवर उपलब्ध योजनांची संख्या आता 105 झाली आहे. याशिवाय आणखी 231 योजनांचे काम प्रक्रियेत असल्याची माहिती देण्यात आली. शासनाच्या उर्वरित सर्व योजनाही टप्प्याटप्प्याने या एकाच व्यासपीठावर आणण्याचा प्रयत्न असून, त्याद्वारे नागरिकांना शासकीय योजनांचा लाभ घेणे अधिक सोपे होईल, असा विश्वास मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. महा-डीबीटीची व्यवस्था सुरू झाल्यापासून शासनाच्या विविध योजनांच्या अंमलबजावणीत पारदर्शकता आणि उत्तरदायित्व वाढले असून, योजनांचा गैरवापर लक्षणीयरीत्या कमी झाला आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, पात्र लाभार्थ्यांपर्यंत थेट आणि योग्य पद्धतीने लाभ पोहोचविण्यासाठी डिजिटल प्रणाली अधिक सक्षम करण्यावर शासनाचा भर आहे. शासनाच्या ‘सेकंड जनरेशन रिफॉर्म्स’ अंतर्गत महा-डीबीटी व्यवस्था अधिक सक्षम, कार्यक्षम आणि विश्वासार्ह करण्याचे काम सुरू आहे. विविध विभागांच्या योजनांचे टप्प्याटप्प्याने ऑनबोर्डिंग करण्यात येत असून, भविष्यात शासनाच्या सर्व प्रमुख योजना या एकाच डिजिटल व्यासपीठावर उपलब्ध करून देण्याचे उद्दिष्ट आहे. त्यामुळे नागरिकांना वेगवेगळ्या कार्यालयांमध्ये किंवा पोर्टलवर जाण्याची आवश्यकता कमी होऊन सेवा वितरण अधिक सुलभ होईल. आज शुभारंभ करण्यात आलेल्या 29 योजनांमध्ये इतर मागासवर्गीय विभाग तसेच उच्च व तंत्र शिक्षण विभागाच्या योजनांचा समावेश आहे. या योजनांची महा-डीबीटीवर यशस्वीपणे सुरुवात केल्याबद्दल मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी संबंधित दोन्ही विभागांचे अभिनंदन केले. शासकीय सेवा आणि योजनांचा लाभ नागरिकांना घरबसल्या अथवा जवळच्या सेवा केंद्रातून कमीत कमी अडचणींसह मिळावा, यासाठी भविष्यातही नागरिककेंद्री डिजिटल सुधारणांना अधिक वेग देण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. महा-डीबीटी 2.0 विविध योजनांसाठी एकाच ठिकाणी अर्ज करण्याची सुविधा नागरिककेंद्रित एकात्मिक प्रणाली महा-डीबीटी 2.0 ने दिली आहे. सिंगल साइन-ऑन, रिअल-टाइम मॉनिटरिंगसाठी लाईव्ह डॅशबोर्ड आणि ‘नो युवर बेनिफिट’ यांसारख्या सुविधा या पोर्टलमध्ये उपलब्ध आहेत. ऑफलाईन प्रक्रियेतून ऑनलाइन प्रक्रियेकडे संक्रमण करताना मंजुरीची प्रक्रिया सुलभ करण्यावर तसेच नवीन योजना समाविष्ट करण्यासाठी लागणारा वेळ कमी करण्यावर भर देण्यात आला आहे. पोर्टलवर आधार कार्ड आधारित पडताळणी, एंड-टू-एंड डिजिटल प्रक्रिया आणि पारदर्शक थेट लाभ हस्तांतरण (डीबीटी) यामुळे योजनांच्या अंमलबजावणीत पारदर्शकता व उत्तरदायित्व वाढण्यास मदत होणार आहे. यावेळी मंत्री ॲड. आशिष शेलार व इतर वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @ShelarAshish #Maharashtra I would bring the sailor up to my office and have a big family meeting on speaker phone to address her complaints. 8/10 the kid would apologize after hanging up. Usually, he would say something like “sorry, my mom just worries a lot. I told her a few things and she made it a big deal.” 1/10 the kid just really didn’t want to be there and was looking for an excuse to quit, which was easy to provide…. usually with mom’s help. 1/10 there were some serious problems at home, and I’d send him off on the next helicopter to go deal with it. This frustrated the heck out of me for years until I went to a funeral and stayed with a friends family. This family is among the most loving and supportive people I know, but once the door closed at home, all they did all weekend was complain to their mom and listen to her worry about everything they said. Was it healthy? No. Was it stressful? Yes. But the mom’s dad grew up in an orphanage, and the dad grew up poor. Like lost siblings poor. It’s the way they learned to communicate their love. It’s not great, but on a ship with over 5,000, in combat, on an extended deployment… it’s zero surprise to me that some moms are worried and some kids complain to them. Maybe the Navy should invest a few million in helping families understand the power of positive thinking. IDK. What I do know is a kid losing weight and Mom drawing worried conclusions from that is not at all uncommon. It’s certainly not the major news story Jim wants it to be. We are at war. You know what would be a major news story? Combat casualties. But unfortunately for Jim, the naval operation is running too smoothly for now. Jim Acosta (@Acosta) It’s not just happening on the USS Abraham Lincoln. The mother of a sailor who served aboard the USS Tripoli sent me text messages about the poor living conditions her son experienced. If social media posts of Judge Hamayoun Dilawar are authentic (Tosha Khana Case Judge), this is alarming and raises serious and reasonable doubts on credibility of trial being conducted by him. In my view, propriety demands that he should immediately recuse or disassociate himself from the case. It needs to be noted that Seven Member Bench of the Supreme Court of Pakistan in Malik Qayyum Case (reported in 2001 PLD SC 568) held that bias on part of the judge vitiates judicial proceedings. The court further held that an accused has a right of a fair trial by a judicial minded person, not by someone functioning under an influence or bias as the same paralyses his judicial faculties to conduct fair trial. Bias would vitiate judicial proceedings if such circumstances exist. Bias robs the judge of the confidence that a litigant may have in the judge. Court further held that bias is mental disposition or attitude towards a particular person and covers all kind of hostilities and prejudices against him.

Students had made preparations for the flag-hoisting ceremony at Jaipal Singh Munda Stadium. We had also provided written notification to the DC, the SDM, and the hospital management regarding this... By 9 AM, the administration and hospital management stated that they would let me go to hoist the flag. Then, within 20-21 minutes, they initially said a vehicle was arriving to take us there, but suddenly, we were attacked. The police pounced on us in a highly aggressive manner. They wanted to force us inside and lock us in with full might... I pleaded with them not to lock the door or close the gate. At that point, the entire police force pounced on us, and the companions who were trying to protect me were brutally beaten and thrown to the ground..." He adds, "I am on a hunger strike for 14 days. I have somehow been holding on, breathing, and surviving, sustained by love and blessings. I am talking about reforming the education system. On Independence Day, 80 years after gaining independence, it deeply distresses me to see this. Is this the nation envisioned through the sacrifices of Bhagat Singh and Subhash Chandra Bose? Is this the nation of Ambedkar's and Gandhi's dreams? What is my crime? I am merely trying to improve the education system. I am following the paths of Gandhi, Bhagat Singh, and Ambedkar. Today, on Independence Day, I expressed a desire to hoist the flag and participate in the Tiranga Yatra. Is that such a grave crime? It has been six hours now, and I am lying here in this corridor. Speaking is causing strain on my heart. If I have made a mistake, committed a crime, or am at fault, then the government should take action against me... I will accept that. But if I am not at fault, then I want justice... I, Devendra Nath Mahto, whether I live or die is not what matters... महा-डीबीटीवर 29 नवीन योजनांसह आता 105 योजना, लाभार्थ्यांसाठी सुलभता! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या हस्ते आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे महा-डीबीटी 2.0 अंतर्गत 29 नवीन योजनांचा शुभारंभ करण्यात आला. नागरिकांना विविध शासकीय योजनांचा सुलभतेने लाभ मिळावा, हा या उपक्रमाचा उद्देश असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. राज्यातील नागरिकांना विविध वैयक्तिक योजनांचा लाभ अधिक सुलभ, पारदर्शक आणि प्रभावी पद्धतीने मिळावा, यासाठी महा-डीबीटी पोर्टलवर आज नव्याने 29 योजनांचे लोकार्पण (ऑनबोर्डिंग) करण्यात आले. त्यामुळे महा-डीबीटीवर उपलब्ध योजनांची संख्या आता 105 झाली आहे. याशिवाय आणखी 231 योजनांचे काम प्रक्रियेत असल्याची माहिती देण्यात आली. शासनाच्या उर्वरित सर्व योजनाही टप्प्याटप्प्याने या एकाच व्यासपीठावर आणण्याचा प्रयत्न असून, त्याद्वारे नागरिकांना शासकीय योजनांचा लाभ घेणे अधिक सोपे होईल, असा विश्वास मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी व्यक्त केला. महा-डीबीटीची व्यवस्था सुरू झाल्यापासून शासनाच्या विविध योजनांच्या अंमलबजावणीत पारदर्शकता आणि उत्तरदायित्व वाढले असून, योजनांचा गैरवापर लक्षणीयरीत्या कमी झाला आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, पात्र लाभार्थ्यांपर्यंत थेट आणि योग्य पद्धतीने लाभ पोहोचविण्यासाठी डिजिटल प्रणाली अधिक सक्षम करण्यावर शासनाचा भर आहे. शासनाच्या ‘सेकंड जनरेशन रिफॉर्म्स’ अंतर्गत महा-डीबीटी व्यवस्था अधिक सक्षम, कार्यक्षम आणि विश्वासार्ह करण्याचे काम सुरू आहे. विविध विभागांच्या योजनांचे टप्प्याटप्प्याने ऑनबोर्डिंग करण्यात येत असून, भविष्यात शासनाच्या सर्व प्रमुख योजना या एकाच डिजिटल व्यासपीठावर उपलब्ध करून देण्याचे उद्दिष्ट आहे. त्यामुळे नागरिकांना वेगवेगळ्या कार्यालयांमध्ये किंवा पोर्टलवर जाण्याची आवश्यकता कमी होऊन सेवा वितरण अधिक सुलभ होईल. आज शुभारंभ करण्यात आलेल्या 29 योजनांमध्ये इतर मागासवर्गीय विभाग तसेच उच्च व तंत्र शिक्षण विभागाच्या योजनांचा समावेश आहे. या योजनांची महा-डीबीटीवर यशस्वीपणे सुरुवात Prezydent RP @NawrockiKn: Naród polski po roku 1918 nie budował swojej siły z myślenia wyłącznie o dobrobycie i o pieniądzach. To był Naród, który miał ideę, silny naród i silne społeczeństwo, choć podzielony politycznie. Ale wówczas w 1920 roku wszyscy wiedzieli, że spory polityczne kończą się tam, gdzie zaczyna się bezpieczeństwo Rzeczypospolitej, gdzie zaczyna się żołnierz i wojsko polskie. Dlatego udało się wygrać w roku 1920, bo silny, odporny Naród wiedział, że żeby móc się sprzeczać o przyszłość i o politykę, to trzeba mieć Polskę. Żeby móc się o Polskę spierać, to trzeba Polskę obronić. Wszyscy stanęli razem, obok siebie – rolnicy obok ziemian, inteligenci obok robotników. Silny, odporny Naród dał zwycięstwo roku 1920. तरुणाईच्या नव्या विचारांनी प्रशासनाला नवी दिशा मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत मुख्यमंत्री फेलोशिप कार्यक्रम सत्कार व शुभारंभ सोहळा 2026 पार पडला. मुख्यमंत्री फेलोशिप कार्यक्रमामुळे प्रशासनाला नव्या पिढीचा दृष्टिकोन, नावीन्यपूर्ण कल्पना आणि तंत्रज्ञानाची जोड मिळेल. फेलोंनी फेलोशिपच्या अनुभवातून आपल्या कार्यक्षेत्रात परिवर्तन घडविण्याचे काम करावे. विकसित महाराष्ट्र आणि विकसित भारताच्या निर्मितीत युवा पिढीची भूमिका महत्त्वपूर्ण असल्याचे नमूद करून मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, सरकारमध्ये अनुभवी आणि गुणवत्तापूर्ण अधिकारी असले तरी दीर्घकाळ एकाच पद्धतीने काम करताना कल्पकता आणि ग्राउंडशी असलेला संपर्क काही प्रमाणात कमी होऊ शकतो. त्यामुळे प्रशासनात नवे विचार आणणे आणि त्याचवेळी तरुणांना शासनाची कार्यपद्धती समजून देणे, हा फेलोशिप कार्यक्रमाचा प्रमुख उद्देश आहे. ‘फेलोशिप’ हा एकतर्फी अनुभव नसून फेलोंकडून प्रशासनालाही नवे विचार आणि दृष्टिकोन मिळतो. नवीन पिढीच्या आकांक्षा आणि कार्यपद्धती समजून घेतल्याशिवाय सर्वसमावेशक प्रशासन शक्य नाही. त्यामुळे प्रशासनाने बदल स्वीकारत अधिक गतिमान होणे आवश्यक आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. सीएम फेलोंनी स्टार्टअप धोरण, महाराष्ट्र स्टेट इनोव्हेशन सोसायटी, जिल्हास्तरीय वॉर रूम्स, विविध डॅशबोर्ड्स, जलयुक्त शिवाराचे जीआयएस मॅपिंग, ‘मागेल त्याला शेततळे’, ई-गव्हर्नन्स, तक्रार निवारण व्यवस्था, चॅटबॉट्स तसेच महाराष्ट्र युनिक इन्फ्रा आयडी यांसारख्या उपक्रमांमध्ये महत्त्वपूर्ण योगदान दिल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद #WIONWings with @crypttor | This Independence Day, Wings celebrates India through food, history, festivals and wildlife. What does Delhi taste like when you travel back more than a century? We visit five iconic establishments that were serving customers long before India gained independence. Step inside Wenger’s in Connaught Place, dating back to 1926; experience the famous parathas of Old Delhi; visit Kwality, which opened in 1940; cool down at Kuremal Mohan Lal Kulfi Wale, whose story dates to 1908; and sample the flavours of Shyam Sweets, established in 1910. From cakes and kulfi to parathas and classic restaurant fare, these establishments offer a delicious connection to Delhi’s past. This Independence Day, visit the places where Indian history was made. We travel to the Red Fort in New Delhi, Gandhi Smriti, Sabarmati Ashram in Ahmedabad, Jallianwala Bagh in Amritsar and the Partition Museum to understand the people and events that shaped modern India. The celebrations continue beyond Independence Day. We look ahead to some of India’s biggest upcoming festivals, including Onam, Janmashtami and Ganesh Chaturthi, and the destinations where travellers can experience them. India is home to the majority of the world’s wild tigers, making its reserves some of the most important wildlife destinations on Earth. Following a new government report highlighting India’s tiger conservation efforts, we journey through Ranthambore National Park, Satpura Tiger Reserve and Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve, exploring how conservation and responsible tourism can help protect the country's most famous big cat. From eateries that predate independence to landmarks of the freedom movement and forests protecting India's extraordinary wildlife, celebrate India with Wings. #IndependenceDay #DelhiFood #IncredibleIndia #TigerConservation Video

I was very pleased to welcome @UNESCO_DG Khaled El-Enany on his first visit to Ukraine as Director-General of UNESCO. I expressed gratitude for this important visit, his participation in events marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra, and UNESCO’s continued support for Ukraine. I’m confident that Director-General’s visit would provide additional impetus to further strengthening our cooperation and is an important step in Ukraine-UNESCO relations. Following Russia’s latest deadly attacks, we focused on the protection of Ukraine’s cultural heritage, including the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra, and UNESCO’s continued monitoring of Ukraine’s World Heritage sites threatened and damaged by Russian deliberate strikes. Culture, education, science, and historical heritage are foundations of our identity and national resilience, as well as integral elements of Ukraine’s security. Russia understands their importance very well. This is precisely why it targets them as part of its broader aggression against our country. We value UNESCO’s role in mobilizing international support for Ukraine and discussed how to deepen our cooperation across these areas. Ukraine, for its part, will continue actively contributing to UNESCO’s work and strengthening international mechanisms for protecting cultural heritage in times of armed conflict. We took a look back at the history of Ukraine-UNESCO relations through a special exhibition of archival documents. We also drew Director-General El-Enany’s particular attention to the Archive of the Ukrainian Republican Capella (1919–1929), recently nominated for inscription on UNESCO’s Memory of the World International Register. I thanked Director-General El-Enany for his personal engagement and leadership. We count on UNESCO’s continued principled voice, practical support, and firm response to Russia’s attacks against Ukrainian culture, education, and science. Despite an overwhelmingly Hindu population, its Muslim ruler announced accession to Pakistan; a decision that triggered a popular revolt, the formation of a provisional government and a tense standoff with India. The Nawab eventually fled to Pakistan, and on November 9, 1947, Junagadh’s administration invited India to take over. But the final word came through a plebiscite held on February 20, 1948, when an overwhelming majority voted in favour of joining India. From the Aarzi Hukumat led by Samaldas Gandhi to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s visit and the rebuilding of Somnath, the Junagadh episode remains a significant, yet lesser-known, chapter in India’s integration after independence. "I can't say for sure, but he retired with dignity after a stellar career. His performance in the final days of his career was outstanding. Current Indian goalkeepers have played in the Pro League and against big teams, and they would have learned a lot from working with a legend like Sreejesh." Pakistan have not defeated India since 2016, and Akbar believes the upcoming clash offers his former team an opportunity to end that wait. "Recently, India defeated Pakistan easily in the Pro League, but I believe Pakistan will try to avenge that. People enjoy watching India-Pakistan hockey. This match is crucial for hockey. Pakistan hasn't won against India since 2016, and this is a golden opportunity. I wish both teams the best of luck and hope to see good hockey, and warm handshakes," he said. Video

VIDEO | Amstelveen, The Netherlands: Former Pakistan hockey team captain Salman Akbar, and two-time Olympian who has also been working as a goalkeeping coach with Japan since 2018, said India's turnaround following its failure to qualify for the 2008 Olympics was the result of sustained investment rather than a quick fix. India has since won Olympic bronze medals at Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024, a gold at the 2023 Asian Games and multiple podium finishes at the Commonwealth Games and Asian Champions Trophy. "This generation is fortunate to have come of age at a time when Indian hockey had just recovered from the shock of failing to qualify for the 2008 Beijing Olympics. India then worked on its domestic structure. Today, they have the Hockey India League and a busy year-round schedule. The results were achieved, not in a year or two, but only until the Tokyo Olympics," he said. Video

With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The amount of endpoint visibility coming out of Computer History (new Codex feature) is kinda wild. Some EDR vendors might be getting jealous 😂 You’re potentially getting clicks, typing, keyboard shortcuts, app switches and macOS Accessibility context, with raw interaction events retained locally for up to 48 hours. Then you also have persistent Markdown memories under ~/.codex/memories/extensions/skysight/. For threat hunting and DFIR, that gives you another source to correlate with process, network and application activity when reconstructing what happened on a Mac, which is very challenging already for most EDR vendors. Check out what EDR vendors can currently see here: edr-telemetry.com/macos Renzon (@r3nzsec) @OpenAI just launched a new feature last night called Computer History. For DFIR analysts, this is a new artifact class worth knowing about. I turned it on on my MacBook, parsed the artifacts, and it produced about 3,616 timeline events from ~2 hours of normal work. While Computer History is on, it logs input, app focus, and what was on screen, then stores it on the Mac. It keeps a timed record of what you clicked, typed, and opened, including chats in Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, and other apps. That record stays on the Mac. IRFlow-Timeline 1.0.10 now parses those Computer History artifacts and builds a timeline of the activity, so you can walk the investigation instead of grepping raw cache files. On a compromised Mac, this shows what was typed, clicked, and read. In 1964, days after China tested its first bomb, Homi Bhabha went on the radio and said the thing nobody wanted said out loud. A country that can be hurt without any means of hurting back has no foreign policy. It only has requests. What he did next is the part worth remembering. India had almost no uranium, and America had built its nuclear programme the way a country with plenty of uranium would. So Bhabha did not bother copying America, nor did he pretend the shortage away. India held a quarter of the world's thorium, so he designed a three-stage programme around that one advantage. Each stage was built to make the scarce input matter less. That is the standard this piece holds up against India's AI moment. And the numbers are not comfortable. Where does India actually stand? - The national compute pool has about 38,000 GPUs, spread across several providers - xAI put 200,000 into a single connected cluster in under a year, and has since crossed half a million - Alphabet alone expects to spend about $200 billion in 2026 - India's entire defence budget for FY27 is $82 billion - The IndiaAI Mission's yearly budget is roughly what Google's India AI hub spends in a month The authors' point is not that the chip count is small. It is that scattered chips across many providers cannot do what one connected cluster does. There is also significant progress alongside this. - Reliance has committed around $110 billion over seven years. - Neysa raised up to $1.2 billion to deploy 20,000 GPUs. - Sarvam is building Indian-language models. - Tata's Dholera fab is coming up. But a data centre in India still runs on foreign chips, foreign networks and foreign model architectures. India can improve in absolute terms and still lose ground to people whose advantages compound faster. Then comes the harder argument, and this is where the essay stops being about technology. Middle power, the authors say, is not a size category. It is a bargain. You accept a ceiling on your autonomy, and in exchange somebody else's umbrella covers your security, which frees you to specialise economically. Japan took that deal in 1945. It worked, and Japan is now a top-tier economy trying to buy back its own security, late and struggling. India, they argue, should refuse the bargain. But refusal has a price. You cannot decline the umbrella and then plan as though you are standing under one. The incoherence they name in Indian strategic thinking is sharp — middle power economics, great power ambition, and nothing in between. Two things they say India cannot afford to get wrong: - Own one frontier that compounds, where this year's work makes next year's cheaper. Medicine and energy are their candidates, because India already has the manufacturing base and the cheap solar that others still have to build. - Keep defence, courts, identity, payments and the grid running on models India can inspect and hardware India controls. Neither asks India to be first at everything. Together they mark the smallest set of things India cannot afford to be second at. There is also a warning about the obvious political reflex, which will be to protect jobs by slowing adoption. Foreign customers will not keep paying for expensive human labour because Indian regulation requires it. Protect people, the authors argue, not production methods the world has already moved past. Achyut Tiwari and Aakarsh Bengani write in @SwarajyaMag: - on the sovereignty gap, - the Taiwan lesson from 1973, -why open-source models may be India's version of a technology licence, and - what it would take to close the distance. The piece ends on the question in its title. For nuclear weapons, India had Bhabha and a handful of people with no tolerance for excuses. For AI, who? swarajyamag.com/commentary/w…

We would welcome further UN Tourism initiatives for Ukrainian veterans, particularly in education and professional development, as well as broader cooperation with Ukraine as we rebuild and recover. Pakistan’s Tomato Crisis: More Than Just Bad Luck Fuel price shocks, extreme weather and disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz are exposing the fragility of Pakistan’s food supply chain. But the huge gap between wholesale and retail tomato prices—around Rs150/kg wholesale versus Rs300–400/kg at retail—also points to weak market oversight and inefficient supply chains. The solution is not another reactive import or price-control measure. Pakistan needs off-season cultivation, cold storage and pack-houses, buffer stocks, and a data-driven early-warning system linking prices, rainfall and flood risks. As *Dr. Inayat Ullah* , Chief of Research & Director, Centre for Agriculture, Climate Change and Rural Economy at PIDE, argues: Pakistan’s tomato crisis is a stress test for a thin supply chain. The real question is whether the next shock finds us better prepared. आज पूरा देश उत्साह, उमंग और उल्लास के साथ स्वतंत्रता दिवस मना रहा है। ये स्वतंत्रता दिवस... आज इसलिए और ऐतिहासिक है, क्योंकि भारत के स्वतंत्रता समर के युगांतकारी गीत, राष्ट्रीय गीत ‘वंदे मातरम्’ 14-15 अगस्त 1947 की रात स्वतंत्र भारत की पहली संविधान सभा, जब प्रारंभ हुई थी, तो इसी वंदे मातरम् गीत के साथ प्रारंभ हुई थी। वही वंदे मातरम्... जिसे गाते हुए लाखों लोगों ने लाठियां, गोलियां खाईं और हजारों लोग फांसी के फंदे पर झूल गए और जिसे कांग्रेस की सत्ता की सुविधा और सत्ता लोलुपता की राजनीति ने अपनी तुष्टिकरण और कट्टरवादी ताकतों के आगे कुर्बान करके एक-चौथाई कर दिया था। परंतु पीएम श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी के संकल्प से, करोड़ों-करोड़ों भारतवासियों की भावनाओं के अनुरूप, ये पहला स्वतंत्रता दिवस है जब वंदे मातरम् संपूर्ण रूप में गाया गया। लेकिन उसी के साथ एक बहुत ही विचित्र, विडंबनापूर्ण और दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण दृश्य देखने को मिला। जब कांग्रेस कार्यालय में वंदे मातरम् गीत गाया जा रहा था, उस समय कांग्रेस की सुप्रीम लीडर सोनिया गांधी, सुपर अध्यक्ष राहुल गांधी और वर्तमान अध्यक्ष मल्लिकार्जुन खड़गे बहुत ही विचित्र और आपत्तिजनक तरीके से असम्मान व्यक्त करते हुए, एक-दूसरे से बातचीत करते हुए नजर आए और किसी को बुलाते हुए नजर आए। कोई व्यक्ति उन्हें आकर कुछ बता भी रहा था और वो लोग एक-दूसरे को इशारे भी कर रहे थे... यह राष्ट्र गीत वंदे मातरम् के प्रति उनका अपमान है, जिससे करोड़ों-करोड़ों भारतवासी बहुत आघात महसूस कर रहे हैं। ये दर्शाता है कि कांग्रेस पार्टी अभी भी संभवत: राष्ट्रीय गीत वंदे मातरम् को संपूर्ण रूप से स्वीकार नहीं कर पाई है। इसलिए, हम कांग्रेस के सर्वोच्च नेतृत्व के इस आचरण की निंदा करते हैं और ये अपेक्षा करते हैं कि कांग्रेस पार्टी देश से इसके लिए माफी मांगे और यह स्पष्टीकरण दे कि उन्होंने ऐसा आचरण क्यों किया? यदि कांग्रेस ऐसा नहीं करती है तो संविधान के प्रति उनकी सच्ची निष्ठा और स्वतंत्रता संग्राम के प्रति उनकी श्रद्धा और करोड़ों भारतवासियों के मान-सम्मान के प्रति उनके विश्वास पर गहरा प्रश्नचिन्ह खड़ा होता है। - डॉ. @SudhanshuTrived Video

स्वातंत्र्याचा गौरवशाली वारसा, विकसित भारताचा संकल्प! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी आज भारतीय स्वातंत्र्य दिनानिमित्त त्यांच्या शासकीय निवासस्थानी व मंत्रालय, मुंबई येथे ध्वजारोहण केले. त्याचबरोबर मुंबई उच्च न्यायालय येथे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत व मुंबई उच्च न्यायालयाचे कार्यवाहक मा. मुख्य न्यायाधीश रवींद्र वी. घुगे यांच्या हस्ते भारतीय स्वातंत्र्य दिनानिमित्त ध्वजारोहण करण्यात आले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी जनतेला स्वातंत्र्यदिनाच्या शुभेच्छा दिल्या. तसेच, भारताच्या स्वातंत्र्यासाठी लढा देणाऱ्या सेनानींना अभिवादन केले आणि देशाच्या रक्षणासाठी वीरमरण पत्करलेल्या शूर जवानांना आदरांजली अर्पण केली. पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या नेतृत्वाखाली भारताने गेल्या 12 वर्षांत विकासाची नवी उंची गाठली आहे. भारत आज जगातील चौथी सर्वात मोठी अर्थव्यवस्था म्हणून पुढे येत असून, 25 कोटींहून अधिक नागरिकांना गरिबीतून बाहेर काढण्यात यश आले आहे. आपण आता विकसित भारताच्या दिशेने वाटचाल करत आहोत. विकसित भारत ही केवळ मोठी किंवा विकसित अर्थव्यवस्था उभारण्याची संकल्पना नाही, तर समाजातील प्रत्येक व्यक्तीच्या जीवनात सकारात्मक परिवर्तन घडवून आणणे, सर्वांची उन्नती व प्रगती साधणे आणि सर्वांना सोबत घेऊन विकासाची वाटचाल करणे, हीच विकसित भारताची खरी संकल्पना आहे. विकसित भारताच्या संकल्पनेत महाराष्ट्राची भूमिका अत्यंत महत्त्वाची असेल, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, महाराष्ट्राचे आराध्य दैवत छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज यांच्या शिकवणीवर आधारित व महामानव भारतरत्न डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर यांनी दिलेल्या संविधानाच्या चौकटीत राहून महाराष्ट्र सातत्याने विकास करत आहे. या वर्षाच्या पहिल्या सहामाहीत महाराष्ट्राचा आर्थिक विकासदर 8.8% इतका नोंदवण्यात आला आहे. महाराष्ट्रातील प्रत्येक जिल्हा हा विकासाचे 'ग्रोथ इंजिन' बनला पाहिजे, या प्रयत्नात जवळपास 13 जिल्ह्यांनी आपले निर्धारित लक्ष्य पूर्ण केले असून, इतर जिल्हेही विकासाच्या दिशेने वेगाने वाटचाल करत आहेत. सरकार ‘पुण्यश्लोक अहिल्यादेवी होळकर शेतकरी कर्जमुक्ती योजना 2026’ अंतर्गत 56 लाख शेतकऱ्यांना कर्जमाफीचा लाभ देत आहे. तसेच, सध्या 76% शेतकऱ्यांना दिवसा वीज उपलब्ध करून दिली जात आहे. पुढील वर्षभरात 100% शेतकऱ्यांना दिवसा वीज देण्याचा संकल्प सरकार पूर्ण करणार असल्याचेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी सांगितले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, 'महाराष्ट्र महिला शेतकरी सक्षमीकरण विधेयक, 2026' अंतर्गत कायदा तयार करून देशामध्ये महिलांना शेतकरी दर्जा देण्याचा निर्णय घेणारे महाराष्ट्र हे पहिले राज्य आहे. महाराष्ट्रातील युवकांना जागतिक दर्जाचे शिक्षण मिळावे यासाठी 'एज्युसिटी'च्या माध्यमातून परदेशी विद्यापीठांना राज्यात आणले जात आहे. राज्यातील विद्यापीठांचा दर्जा उंचावण्यासोबतच आधुनिक आणि 'कटिंग-एज' शिक्षण उपलब्ध करून देण्याचे प्रयत्न सुरू आहेत. यासह महाराष्ट्र देशाचे 'स्टार्टअप कॅपिटल' बनले असून राज्यात सर्वाधिक गुंतवणूक आणि परकीय गुंतवणूक होत आहे, त्यामुळे युवकांसाठी रोजगाराच्या मोठ्या प्रमाणावर संधी निर्माण होत असल्याचेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी नमूद केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, आज स्वातंत्र्यदिनाच्या निमित्ताने आपण सर्वांनी आपल्या संविधानिक अधिकारांसोबतच संविधानाने सांगितलेल्या कर्तव्यांचेही भान ठेवण्याचा संकल्प करूया. आपला तिरंगा सदैव उंचच उंच राहील, यासाठी Happy birthday Louis de Broglie, a prominent physicist known for his contributions to the field of quantum mechanics in physics. French physicist de Broglie worked on wave-particle duality which had implications for the study of radioactivity. He suggested that the decay of radioactive nuclei could be explained as the emission of particles that behaved like waves, and that the energy of these particles was related to their frequency. In the early 1920s, de Broglie proposed that particles could behave like waves, and that the wavelength of these waves was related to the momentum of the particle. This idea was later confirmed through experiments and became one of the fundamental principles of quantum mechanics. In 1929, de Broglie applied his wave-particle duality concept to nuclear physics. The same year, the Nobel Prize in Physics 1929 was awarded to him for his “discovery of the wave nature of electrons”. De Broglie's contributions to nuclear physics helped to deepen our understanding of the behavior of atomic nuclei and the properties of radioactive materials.

Women "own" the majority of India's unincorporated manufacturing establishments. But what does ownership mean? ASUSE 2025 data shows that 67% of own-account manufacturing establishments (sole proprietorships with no hired workers) are headed by women, compared with just 7% of manufacturing establishments that employ at least one worker. The important caveat here is that "ownership" often just describes who does the work, rather than entrepreneurship in the conventional sense. And what women produce varies sharply across States and UTs. In Telangana and West Bengal, more than half of women's own-account manufacturing establishments are in tobacco products — likely reflecting their large presence in bidi-rolling work. In most other states, wearing apparel dominates, that often represent custom tailors. It is the largest category among women's own-account manufacturing establishments in 18 of 21 major states, accounting for an extraordinary 98% in Bihar and 92% in Maharashtra. The exception is Jammu & Kashmir, where textiles are the leading category, at 56%. These numbers raise an important question about how we interpret women's presence in manufacturing. When we celebrate women as "owners" of manufacturing establishments, we should also ask whether these pathways into entrepreneurship are simply another form of precarious work. The ASUSE data shows that a high share of women owning manufacturing enterprises does not necessarily mean a high level of business growth or economic agency. In many cases, it may instead reflect home-based, informal and highly labour-intensive work with limited possibilities to scale-up and little separation between the worker and the enterprise. Therefore, the policy challenge is to help women move from survival-oriented own-account work to growth-oriented entrepreneurship. Technology can help women access wider markets and improve productivity; skilling can help them diversify beyond low-value activities; and financial literacy and access to appropriate finance can help them manage and grow their businesses. #WomenInManufacturing #WomenEntrepreneurs #FemaleEmployment #Gender #ASUSE2025

Cyril Ramaphosa's sudden, hand-wringing panic over the continued erosion of South Africa's industrial base is the absolute peak of political gaslighting. For the President to stand at a podium and declare manufacturing "fundamental to our economic sovereignty" while his own administration actively strangles the private sector is pure theater. The industrial base isn't eroding because of external bad luck. It is being systematically dismantled by the ANC's own ideological obsessions: BBBEE and cadre deployment. Ramaphosa laments a dying industrial base while forcing capital intensive, high risk manufacturing firms to navigate an oppressive maze of BBBEE compliance. Foreign and domestic investors are not looking for compliance lectures; they are looking for economic viability. When you prioritize skin color and political connections over global competitiveness, investors pack up and take their factories to Vietnam, India, or Mauritius. You cannot have a manufacturing sector without electricity, rail, and ports. Ramaphosa's sacred cow, cadre deployment, has stuffed the boards of Transnet, Eskom, and Prasa with incompetent party loyalists instead of technocrats. By turning state owned enterprises into patronage feeding troughs, his government has made it impossible for factories to reliably power their machinery or move their goods to port. It is laughably hypocritical to talk about economic sovereignty when your state's economic policy has rendered the country completely dependent on Chinese loans, IMF bailouts, and Western green-energy handouts. Local businesses are shutting down because the cost of doing business in South Africa, driven by rigid labor laws, state extortion, and broken infrastructure, is too high. The ANC has successfully colonized the economy with red tape, ensuring that only politically connected elites survive while real entrepreneurs go under. Ramaphosa has mastered the art of speaking like a concerned observer rather than the head of the executive. He laments the crisis as if he didn't spend the last decade chairing the committee that oversaw the deployment of the very cadres who broke the state. No amount of social compacting or high-level investment summits can undo the damage of a state policy framework designed to extract wealth rather than create it. Manufacturing requires cheap electricity, functional railways, and regulatory certainty. Ramaphosa's administration offers the exact opposite, erratic power, stalled trains, and aggressive racial engineering. If the President truly cares about South Africa's industrial base, he needs to stop diagnosing the disease and look at the ideological poison his own party keeps feeding the patient. زنان معترض: پنج سال حاکمیت طالبان با سرکوب، تبعیض و نقض حقوق بشر گذشت اعضای «جنبش زنان پنجره‌ی امید» و «شبکه حمایت از زنان افغانستان» با برگزاری یک تجمع اعتراضی به‌مناسبت ۲۴ اسد، پنجمین سالروز سقوط افغانستان به‌دست طالبان می‌گویند پنج سال حاکمیت طالبان با «سرکوب، تبعیض و نقض حقوق بشر» گذشت. این بانوان معترض در یک تجمع اعتراضی شعارهای «تحصیل، کار، آزادی» و «نه به طالبان، آری به آزادی» سر دادند و خواستار پایان دادن به آپارتاید جنسیتی اعمال‌شده از سوی طالبان در افغانستان شدند. اعضای این دو جنبش اعتراضی زنان افغانستان از سازمان ملل متحد، دولت‌ها و نهادهای بین‌المللی خواسته‌اند که «در برابر وضعیت افغانستان به ابراز نگرانی اکتفا نکنند؛ از عادی‌سازی و مشروعیت‌بخشی سیاسی به طالبان بدون پیشرفت واقعی و قابل‌سنجش در زمینه‌ی حقوق بشر خودداری کنند» و فشارهای مؤثر برای پایان سرکوب و تبعیض اعمال نمایند. آنان همچنین تأکید کرده‌اند که هیچ روند سیاسی درباره‌ی آینده‌ی افغانستان نباید بدون حضور واقعی، مستقل و معنادار زنان افغانستان برگزار شود. In 1947, as India gained independence, the princely state of Junagadh took a dramatically different path. Despite an overwhelmingly Hindu population, its Muslim ruler announced accession to Pakistan; a decision that triggered a popular revolt, the formation of a provisional government and a tense standoff with India. The Nawab eventually fled to Pakistan, and on November 9, 1947, Junagadh’s administration invited India to take over. But the final word came through a plebiscite held on February 20, 1948, when an overwhelming majority voted in favour of joining India. From the Aarzi Hukumat led by Samaldas Gandhi to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s visit and the rebuilding of Somnath, the Junagadh episode remains a significant, yet lesser-known, chapter in India’s integration after independence. مشکل اصلی رابطه‌ی طالبان با هند و چین نیست. هیچ نظامی نمی‌تواند بدون رابطه با همسایگان و قدرت‌های منطقه‌ای کشور خود را اداره کند. تعامل با هند، چین، ایران و دیگر کشورها برای هر حکومت حاکم افغانستان یک ضرورت سیاسی و اقتصادی است. مشکل، فاصله میان ادعا و عمل است. طالبان نمی‌توانند از یک‌سو اسلام را معیار مطلق زندگی مردم افغانستان معرفی کنند و از سوی دیگر، هنگامی که پای منافع سیاسی و اقتصادی گروهی‌شان در میان است، همان اصول را در روابط خود با دهلی، پکن و تهران کنار بگذارند یا آن‌ها را تابع مصلحت سیاسی کنند. این مثلث زمانی کامل‌تر می‌شود که بدانیم هر سه رهبر، هنگامی که با جامعه و مخالفان داخلی خود مواجه‌اند، از ایدئولوژی، هویت و ارزش‌ها سخن می‌گویند؛ اما هنگامی که با قدرت‌های خارجی و منافع ژئوپلیتیک روبه‌رو می‌شوند، مصلحت سیاسی و منافع ملی بر ایدئولوژی غلبه می‌کند. و شاید پرسش اصلی پنجمین سالگرد پانزدهم آگست همین باشد: اگر دین برای طالبان حقیقت و معیار عدالت است، چرا این حقیقت در برابر زن افغانستان و مخالف داخلی مطلق به نظر می‌رسد، اما در برابر مودی و شی جین‌پینگ نسبی می‌شود؟ و پرسش دیگر حتا بنیادی‌تر است: اگر مسلمانان یک امت ‌اند و دفاع از آنان یک اصل دینی است، چرا این اصل در برابر غزه به بیانیه تبدیل می‌شود، در برابر برخی بحران‌های جهان اسلام به موضع رسمی می‌انجامد، در برابر ایران با مصلحت سیاسی کنار می‌آید، اما در برابر اویغورها در برابر قدرت چین سکوت اختیار می‌کند؟ این همان مثلث ناقص‌الاضلاع است؛ مثلثی که در هر سه ضلع آن، فاصله میان آنچه رهبران به نام دین، ایدئولوژی و ارزش‌های ملی می‌گویند و آنچه در عمل برای حفظ قدرت و تأمین منافع سیاسی انجام می‌دهند، بیش از هر چیز دیگری خودنمایی می‌کند. در هند، دین در منازعات سیاسی وارد تعریف هویت و شهروندی شده است؛ در چین، دین و هویت اسلامی در چارچوب امنیتی و سیاست کنترل اقلیت اویغور قرار گرفته است؛ و در افغانستان، دین وارد تعریف حقوق، آزادی‌ها و سبک زندگی شهروندان شده است. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/259134

नशे के खिलाफ जंग से खेलों की नई उड़ान तक 🇮🇳 👉🏻 पंजाब सरकार ने नशे के खिलाफ निर्णायक जंग छेड़कर नशा तस्करों की कमर तोड़ दी है। पंजाब के लोगों ने भी इस लड़ाई में सरकार का मजबूती से साथ दिया है। आज पंजाब नशे की गिरफ्त से निकलकर तरक्की और खेल के क्षेत्र में नई ऊँचाइयाँ हासिल कर रहा है। पूरे पंजाब के लिए गर्व की बात है कि- 👉🏻 भारतीय बास्केटबॉल टीम के कप्तान पालप्रीत सिंह बराड़ पंजाबी हैं। 👉🏻 भारतीय हॉकी टीम के कप्तान हरमनप्रीत सिंह पंजाबी हैं। भारतीय हॉकी टीम के 11 खिलाड़ियों में से 9 खिलाड़ी पंजाब से हैं। 👉🏻 भारतीय पुरुष क्रिकेट टीम के कप्तान शुभमन गिल और महिला क्रिकेट टीम की कप्तान हरमनप्रीत कौर भी पंजाब से हैं। 👉🏻 पंजाब के इतिहास में पहली बार खेलों के लिए ₹1,744 करोड़ का बजट रखा गया है, जिससे राज्य की खेल प्रतिभाओं को आगे बढ़ने के नए अवसर मिल रहे हैं। — @BhagwantMann जी, मुख्यमंत्री, पंजाब Video

در پرونده شهرک امید سبز، محکمه‌ی اختصاصی طالبان ثبت زمین در کادستر به‌نام دولت را یکی از مبانی اصلی «امارتی» دانستن زمین‌ها قرار داده است؛ اما اسناد رسمی وزارت عدلیه‌ی طالبان درباره‌ی پرونده‌ای مشابه، نشان می‌دهد که کادستر در همه‌ی پرونده‌ها چنین وزن و اعتباری نداشته است. در قضیه شهرک سید جمال‌الدین افغان، متعلق به میرویس عزیزی، تاجر پشتون‌تبار افغانستان، بیش از هزار و ۱۸۸ جریب زمین با قطعه کادستری شماره ۸۸۸ در اسناد کادستر به‌عنوان زمین «امارتی» ثبت شده بود. بااین‌حال، محکمه‌ی اختصاصی رسیدگی به قضایای زمین‌های غصب‌شده «امارتی»، پس از بررسی قباله‌ها و استفتاء از مفتیان طالبان، زمین را ملکیت شخصی دانست. وزارت عدلیه‌ی طالبان در وب‌سایت خود درباره‌ی این پرونده نوشته است که محکمه در فیصله شماره ۴/۲۳ مورخ ۱۵ شعبان ۱۴۴۵، زمین را با توجه به «فتوای مفتیان» شخصی دانسته و در نهایت کمیسیون جلوگیری از غصب زمین نیز از ادعای خود درباره‌ی این زمین صرف‌نظر کرده است. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/259103

ذبیح‌الله مجاهد، سخن‌گوی طالبان در پیامی به‌مناسبت پنجمین سالروز ورود نیروهای این گروه به کابل و سقوط نظام جمهوری، از مردم افغانستان خواستار حمایت شده است. مجاهد امروز (شنبه، ۲۴ اسد) در پیام تصویری که از طریق تلویزیون ملی منتشر شد، گفته است که پنج سال پیش در چنین روزی «یک جنگ بزرگ و اشغال به پایان رسید» و «زمینه‌ی حاکمیت یک نظام اسلامی فراهم شد». سخن‌گوی طالبان بدون اشاره به سیاست‌های وضع‌شده از سوی این گروه که حقوق و آزادی‌های مردم به‌ویژه نصف نفوس کشور (زنان) را نقض می‌کند، حاکمیت طالبان را یک «نعمت» خواند و از شهروندان خواست از این نظام «حمایت» کنند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/259100

The casualty resulted in a complete loss of power for four days, during which the George Washington Carrier Strike Group provided essential support to the destroyer, including meals, until Benfold was able to reach Subic Bay, Philippines, for repairs. During the outage, the Benfold had limited potable water and no galley, restrooms and climate control.
